claim: An engine's auto must return PASSED on a rebuild with no recording (the record's rebuild recipe): a FAILED auto skips the CLI's later steps such as automap_off, so rebuild and verify MD5s differ.

evidence.text: auto failed with no recording (Unit: no states); the rebuild's .nex lacked the automap_off entry the verify run's had (19 bytes, header PC)
evidence.quote: auto returned FAILED, so the automap_off entry was not added

next_check: selftest could rebuild every new record once with no recording and require Result PASSED.
